title: User
description: FitGH user document stored in the `users` collection. Phase 1 Walking Skeleton ships only the auth-bound minimum (clerk_id + email + timestamps); Phase 2 will extend with profile {name, sex, height, weight, goal} and Phase 3 will reference users[] from the meals[] collection.

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId (assigned by the driver, not by app code).

clerk_id.description: Clerk user id (e.g. user_2abc...). Used as the trust anchor; never invent or accept this from a request body.

email.description: Primary email at sign-up time. Null if Clerk did not provide one (e.g. anonymous OAuth flows — not used in Phase 1).

created_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp written by the user.created webhook handler (Slice F).

updated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp; updated on every webhook event (and on every profile-edit in Phase 2).
